title: Decoding commutes with relabelling
statement: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be types, let $f:\alpha\to\beta$, let $m$ be a natural number, and let $c$ be a perfect-matching code of order $m$. For every list $L$ of elements of $\alpha$, decoding $c$ after applying $f$ to each element of $L$ gives the list obtained by applying $f$ to both endpoints of each decoded pair: $\operatorname{decode}(c,f(L))=\operatorname{map}((x,y)\mapsto(f(x),f(y)),\operatorname{decode}(c,L))$.
